system_prompt_style.note: Mismatch: the code evidence bundled is HKUDS/HELIX, a different system, so it is ignored. For helixml/helix 2.12.7 only the README, docs and file tree were available. No prompt builder was opened. Per-agent system_prompt is a project YAML field (docs/helix-apply.md). The prompt itself is produced by the external harness (Claude Code etc.).

env_context_strategy.note: Context handling is delegated to external harnesses. No helixml source was opened.

context_compaction.note: The docs say Claude Code runtime handles compaction and the zed runtime does not. The compaction is a property of the external harness.

observation_format.note: No observation conversion code for helixml/helix is in the evidence.

tool_call_format.note: Tool calling is done by the external agent harnesses. No parser was opened.

tool_count.note: No tool registry was opened. The docs show optional web_search/browser/calculator toggles.

edit_primitive.note: Editing is done by the external harness.

tool_schema_source.note: The README mentions REST/OpenAPI integrations and MCP, but no schema code was opened.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: REST/OpenAPI integrations, MCP server compatibility, GPTScript, OAuth token management, and a custom-tool SDK
protocol_standardization.note: The other protocol is ACP (Agent Client Protocol). The README lists 'Anything that speaks ACP' among supported agent harnesses.

loop_primitives.note: The run loop belongs to the external harness. The task workflow is a Kanban pipeline.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: A planning agent reads the repo and writes a spec (requirements, design, task breakdown) to a `helix-specs` branch.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: An implementation agent codes in its own isolated desktop sandbox.
multi_agent_topology.note: Planning agent, then human spec review, then implementation agent, then PR. Many tasks run in parallel as a fleet.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: switch to a different agent mid-session — the new one picks up where the last left off
delegation_mechanism.note: This is the closest value. The handoff is between the planning and implementation agents, or between harnesses.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: You describe an outcome as a **spec task**, an agent plans it, you approve the plan, and it implements the change and opens a pull request.
human_in_loop.note: The README also states 'The PR is the real review gate'. Users can steer by typing into the task thread.

long_term_memory.note: The README describes Knowledge/RAG with PGVector, but that is document knowledge, not cross-run memory.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: full chat history and running state persist, no handoff summaries

cost_controls.note: The README mentions metering of token spend and manual escalation between models. No cap or router code was opened.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: many in parallel, each in its own isolated sandbox with a full desktop (browser, terminal, filesystem, GUI apps), on your own infrastructure
execution_isolation.note: Inferred from the Docker-based sandbox. The file tree has Dockerfile.sandbox and the docs refer to the 'Zed desktop container'.

network_policy.note: The README claims 'per-agent credential and network isolation', but the policy details are not shown.

tracing.evidence_quote: every agent step, requests/responses to LLMs, APIs, and MCP servers, token usage, and cost analysis

eval_hooks.note: The file tree lists api/cmd/helix/evals.go, but it was not opened.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Run a fleet of coding agents on your own infrastructure. Each agent gets its own GPU-accelerated desktop

open_source.evidence_quote: Helix is [licensed](https://github.com/helixml/helix/blob/main/LICENSE.md) under a similar license to Docker Desktop.
open_source.note: The source is available, but the licence is not OSI (it has commercial-use and non-compete restrictions). 'no' is the closest value.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: attach any OpenAI-compatible endpoint as an external provider

primary_artifact.note: The HKUDS/HELIX paper (arXiv 2608.13951) is a different system and was attached to this record in error.

stars.note: The only star count in the evidence (41) belongs to HKUDS/HELIX, a different repo.
